Dengar With Blaster Carbine (V) is a Dark Character (Alien) from Virtual Set 0.

Card Text

While opponent's [Reflections 2] objective on table, adds one battle destiny. Permanent weapon is •Dengar's Blaster Carbine (twice per battle, may target a character or vehicle for free; draw destiny; target 'hit,' and its forfeit = 0, if destiny +1 > defense value).

Lore

Corellian bounty hunter. Skilled athlete. Expert shot. Has worked many times for Jabba the Hutt. Carries a long-standing grudge against Han Solo.

  • Double Back[2]
  • Double Back (V)

  • Punishing One
  • Punishing One (V)

  • Corellian

Errata

This is the original printing (version 1 of 2) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is Dengar With Blaster Carbine (V) (Errata) (PC-E1). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version (File:V0-D-dengarwithblastercarbine-2018-07-08.gif). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Errata mark: the earliest image found already prints “E”: the PC had issued an errata of this card before its image repository began (8 July 2018), and no image of the earlier text was found. Listed with the PC transcription errors (marks that do not match the version).

  • Original (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018[3] (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: errata mark “E”; bottom margin “•Dengar With Blaster Carbine”. Text: “While opponent's [Reflections II] objective on table, adds one battle destiny. Permanent weapon is •Dengar's Blaster Carbine (twice per battle, may target a character or vehicle for free; draw destiny; target 'hit,' and its forfeit = 0, if destiny +1 > defense value).”
  • PC-E1 (Dengar With Blaster Carbine (V) (Errata)): PC card image uploaded 31 July 2022[4]. What changed: the errata mark “E” → “E1”; the bottom margin “•Dengar With Blaster Carbine” → “Dengar With Blaster Carbine” (uniqueness dot removed); the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (349×488 → 745×1039 pixels); the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E1”; bottom margin “Dengar With Blaster Carbine”. It is the current image (the same file as the wiki's existing image). Text: “While opponent's [Reflections II] objective on table, adds one battle destiny. Permanent weapon is •Dengar's Blaster Carbine (twice per battle, may target a character or vehicle for free; draw destiny; target 'hit,' and its forfeit = 0, if destiny +1 > defense value).”

Stinger (V) is a Dark Starship (Starfighter) from Virtual Set 0.

Card Text

May add 1 pilot. Guri deploys -3 aboard. While Guri piloting, during any control phase may draw top card of Reserve Deck (if Chewie or Leia on table, Force Pile instead) and immune to attrition < 5.

Lore

Constructed by a secretive Surronian hive craftguild. Equipped with H2-1 hyperdrive system and emergency braking jets. Guri's personal starship. Gift from Prince Xizor.

  • Independent (starship)

Palace Raider is a Light Character (Alien) from Virtual Set 2.

Card Text

[Pilot] 2. Palace Raiders (including this character) are deploy -3 if You're A Slave? on table. While driving a vehicle, it is power +3, defense value +1, and moves for free.

Lore

Smugglers from many worlds are hunted by the Empire for providing arms and supplies to the Alliance. The Outer Rim is their refuge.



Errata

Four source-verified Modern designs are documented in source order. This is the earliest located lower-face design. The supported current full face is Palace Raider (Virtual Set 2) (Errata 3) (202_2). Archive captures establish known-by bounds; neither PDF build metadata nor repository-copy times establish a first-publication day. No additional state is assigned to the pixel-identical2017 copy.

Game text (pilot shorthand transcribed): “[Pilot] 2. Palace Raiders (including this character) are deploy -3 if You’re A Slave? on table. While driving a vehicle, it is power +3, defense value +1, and moves for free.”[2]
  • PC-E1 (Palace Raider (Virtual Set 2) (Errata)): known by 6 August 2016; identical in the 5 July 2017 capture. Actual source: File:PC-Set2-PalaceRaider-2016-08-06-slip.png. Printed mark: no errata mark. Bottom caption: “Palace Raider”. Game text (pilot shorthand transcribed): “[Pilot] 2. Palace Raiders (including this character) deploy -3 if You’re A Slave? on table. While driving a vehicle, it is power +3, defense value +1, and moves for free.”[3]
  • PC-E2 (Palace Raider (Virtual Set 2) (Errata 2)): present in the 8 July 2018 repository copy. Actual source: File:V2-L-palaceraider-2018-07-08.gif. Printed mark: no errata mark. Bottom caption: “Palace Raider”. Game text (pilot shorthand transcribed): “[Pilot] 2. This character (and other Palace Raiders) are deploy -3 if You’re A Slave? on table. While driving a vehicle, it is power +3, defense value +1, and moves for free.”[4]
  • PC-E3 (Palace Raider (Virtual Set 2) (Errata 3)): present in the 26 October 2022 repository copy. Actual source: File:V2-L-palaceraider.gif. Printed mark: E1. Bottom caption: “Palace Raider”. Game text (pilot shorthand transcribed): “[Pilot] 2. While You’re A Slave? on table, Palace Raiders (including this character) deploy -3. While driving a vehicle, it is power +3, defense value +1, and moves for free.”[5]

The lower-face slip visibly supplies power 1, ability 2, deploy 2, forfeit 3, Pilot/Warrior and Set2 icons, game text and “Original concept by Brian Fred”. It does not reproduce the upper card face. Destiny 2, the upper Palace Raider title/lore and Alien type are inherited from the named underlying Decipher card, verified against its unchanged original archive face File:JPSD-L-palaceraider-decipher-archive.gif. Artwork is not reconstructed. Catalogue rarity is not independently established by this crop and is omitted from these new partial articles. Palace Raider is a Light Character (Alien) from Virtual Set 2.

Card Text

[Pilot] 2. Palace Raiders (including this character) deploy -3 if You're A Slave? on table. While driving a vehicle, it is power +3, defense value +1, and moves for free.

Lore

Smugglers from many worlds are hunted by the Empire for providing arms and supplies to the Alliance. The Outer Rim is their refuge.



Errata

Four source-verified Modern designs are documented in source order. This is Errata 1 in that documented sequence. The supported current full face is Palace Raider (Virtual Set 2) (Errata 3) (202_2). While driving a vehicle, it is power +3, defense value +1, and moves for free.”[4]

While driving a vehicle, it is power +3, defense value +1, and moves for free.”[5]
